metric_definitions.article_views: Cumulative counter from api.telegra.ph getViews/getPage under our author token. VERIFIED C89: getPage does NOT increment it; a public page fetch DOES (+1). So the counter is clean human traffic and our own verification never pollutes it.
metric_definitions.unique_visitors: UNKNOWN. Telegraph exposes no visitor identifier. Never infer from views.
metric_definitions.outbound_clicks: UNKNOWN. UTM parameters are set and the destination resolves, but with no click-analytics backend there is no observation point. Only attribution would surface at purchase, in Gumroad.
metric_definitions.checkout_starts: UNKNOWN. No instrumentation exists; Gumroad exposes this in the founder dashboard only, not via API.

corrections_this_cycle: The "own-load pollution ~10 (ESTIMATED)" figure carried in earlier handoffs is NOT SUPPORTED. C89 instrumentation test proves getPage does not inflate the counter. Reported view totals were already clean.

measurement_window.NOTE: No continuous monitoring exists. Nothing runs on a timer unless started. Metrics are read at explicit cycle boundaries only.

data_sources.telegraph: https://api.telegra.ph/{getViews,getPage} with author token from gitignored data/telegraph.json
data_sources.storefront: GitHub Pages (static); no backend, no page-view tracking possible
